title: Maximum Difference Between Node and Ancestor
summary: Determine the greatest difference v between the values of any node a and its descendant b in a binary tree, where a is an ancestor of b.
statement: Determine the greatest difference v between the values of any node a and its descendant b in a binary tree, where a is an ancestor of b. An ancestor b is defined as either being a direct child of a or a descendant of a's child.
constraints: The tree is nonempty and values are nonnegative integers.
Maximize the absolute difference between a node and any descendant.
